label: 🐬 MySQL
description: Read a table or custom query from a MySQL / MariaDB database. URI: mysql://user:pass@host:3306/db

table.label: Table name

query.label: Custom SQL query
query.help: Used when 'Table name' is empty. Executed verbatim against MySQL.
